transformation.description: Mask every numerical token in the new disclosure, including table cells, duplicate guidance prose, actuals and year headings. A broad missing-numerical-disclosure control, not an isolated table-parser ablation.

config.selection: Reuse 72 byte-identical v2 synthetic heldout cases and two original supplemental natural withdrawal/rollover cases. B/C use unchanged v8 code; all inputs are exposed regression. No new blind-test claim. Retain frozen uncertain charges and block identical wire requests.

pricing.assumption: Peak rates, all input charged as cache miss; ignore all discounts.

spans.quote: •Second quarter total revenue of $1,162.5 million, up 2.1% year over year as reported and 2.4% in constant currency
•Second quarter Enterprise revenue of $682.8 million, up 3.5% year over year

We also saw strength in large accounts, with customers contributing more than $100,000 in trailing 12 months revenue increasing by 7.1% year over year, and resilience in our Online business, with Online average monthly churn reaching its lowest ever rate,” said Eric S.
•Revenue: Total revenue for the second quarter was $1,162.5 million, up 2.1% year over year.
Adjusting for foreign currency impact, revenue in constant currency was $1,166.1 million, up 2.4% year over year.
Enterprise revenue was $682.8 million, up 3.5% year over year, and Online revenue was $479.7 million, flat year over year.
•3,933 customers contributing more than $100,000 in trailing 12 months revenue, up approximately 7.1% from the same quarter last fiscal year.

•Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2025: Total revenue is expected to be between $1.160 billion and $1.165 billion and revenue in constant currency is expected to be between $1.162 billion and $1.167 billion.
•Full Fiscal Year 2025: Total revenue is expected to be between $4.630 billion and $4.640 billion and revenue in constant currency is expected to be between $4.641 billion and $4.651 billion.
Zoom calculates net dollar expansion rate as of a period end by starting with the annual recurring revenue (“ARR”) from Enterprise customers as of 12 months prior (“Prior Period ARR”).
Zoom calculates ARR by taking the monthly recurring revenue (“MRR”) and multiplying it by 12.
